title: Algerian Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Algerian-inspired casserole made with zesty beans and pillowy texture.

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed
pillowy naan bread, cut into cubes

instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Stir in algerian spice blend; cook 1 minute.
Add canned black beans, diced tomatoes, salt; cook 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, toss cubed naan bread with a pinch of salt.
Spoon the bean mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
